تنتقعوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِعُوا (tantaqiʕū) /tan.ta.qi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# تُنْتَقَعُوا (tuntaqaʕū) /tun.ta.qa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
